title: IPv6: Make full implementation of RFC 6052
description:
Restrict the current UAT for IPv6 address entry only.
Include a selection that allows for all the formats defined in the RFC.
Include a prefix wildcard length, to allow prefix aggregation.
Present the prefix, IPv4, u, and suffix as fields.
